class.name: RSTReferenceIndex
class.brief_description: A generated index for navigation between reStructuredText documents.
class.description: Dockit generates this resource in the editor from the roots configured in [code]dockit/rst/document_roots[/code]. It stores only document targets and labels referenced by the scanned RST files, with a resource path alongside any available UID as a fallback. Projects normally do not need to create or edit it manually.

method.name: get_document_targets
method.description: Returns indexed document paths mapped to target dictionaries containing [code]path[/code], [code]uid[/code], and [code]anchor[/code].

method.name: get_reference_targets
method.description: Returns indexed references keyed by the source document path and normalized label.

method.name: get_source_fingerprint
method.description: Returns the source fingerprint used to skip unnecessary index writes.

method.name: resolve_document
method.description: Resolves an indexed document path or UID. Returns the normalized input path when it is not indexed.

method.name: resolve_reference
method.description: Resolves [param label] as a [code]:ref:[/code] target used by [param source_path], or returns an empty string when there is no unique match.
